name: Demonic Oppression
overview: Scripture reveals that demonic oppression is a real spiritual battle where the power of darkness seeks to blind and silence individuals, as shown in the healing of a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute (Matthew 12:22). Christ’s ministry, empowered by the Spirit, brings deliverance to the captives and freedom to those oppressed (Luke 4:18), granting believers authority over demonic forces (Luke 10:17, 19). This authority is exercised through faith in Jesus’ name, enabling the healing of the sick and casting out of devils as freely received gifts to be freely given (Matthew 10:8). The Lord’s illumination dispels darkness, underscoring God’s power to overcome spiritual oppression (Psalms 18:28).
